title: Aivres NVIDIA Vera Rubin and HGX B300 at OCP Summit
gist: At OCP Global Summit 2026 ServeTheHome toured Aivres' NVIDIA lineup: the KRS8000V4 Vera Rubin NVL72 rack (72 Rubin GPUs, 36 Vera CPUs, 100% liquid-cooled at up to 45C) and the KL2288 fanless 2U HGX Rubin NVL8 tray paired with AMD EPYC 'Venice' CPUs. It is a hardware walkthrough of an upcoming system, with vendor-listed specs rather than independent measurements.

insights.claim: Aivres' KRS8000V4 Vera Rubin NVL72 rack uses 18 1U compute trays and nine 1U NVLink switch trays with power shelves at top and bottom, yielding 72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs on sixth-generation NVLink.
insights.speaker: Vic A
insights.so_what: Rack-scale integration, not the chip alone, is what OEMs like Aivres are now selling.
insights.quote: Aivres lists 18 1U compute trays and nine 1U NVLink switch trays

insights.claim: The NVL72 rack forms a single NVLink GPU domain with over 20TB of HBM, which is the scale-up memory pool that large-model training and inference jobs are being designed around.
insights.speaker: Vic A
insights.so_what: Memory capacity per NVLink domain is a key differentiator versus scale-out Ethernet or InfiniBand clusters.
insights.quote: That creates a giant GPU domain over NVLink with over 20TB of HBM.

insights.claim: Aivres says the rack is 100% liquid-cooled and can run at 45C coolant temperature, which improves cooling efficiency because warmer fluid can be rejected without chillers.
insights.speaker: Vic A
insights.so_what: Warm-water cooling lowers data-center cooling overhead and shapes facility design for Rubin deployments.
insights.quote: Aivres says this is 100% liquid-cooled and can operate at 45C to help cooling efficiency.

insights.claim: The booth rack was a mix of dummy blanks and a live node, and the author notes these racks are hard to transport to trade shows, so show floors give limited evidence of production readiness.
insights.speaker: Vic A
insights.so_what: Trade-show demos are weak evidence of shipment timing for Rubin racks.
insights.quote: At the show, this was a mix of dummy blanks and a live node.
insights.locator: Aivres KRS8000V4 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Rack

insights.claim: Aivres showed the same Vera Rubin rack earlier at its NVIDIA GTC 2026 booth, indicating the design has been on display for months ahead of volume availability.
insights.speaker: Vic A
insights.so_what: Repeated showings suggest the platform is still pre-volume.
insights.quote: We saw the Aivres Vera Rubin rack at its NVIDIA GTC 2026 booth

insights.claim: The Aivres KL2288 is a 2U liquid-cooled tray pairing eight Rubin GPUs from HGX Rubin NVL8 with dual AMD EPYC 9006 'Venice' CPUs, showing x86 hosts will continue to front eight-GPU NVIDIA platforms alongside NVIDIA's own Vera CPU.
insights.speaker: Vic A
insights.so_what: NVIDIA's Vera CPU push has not displaced AMD as a host option in HGX designs.
insights.quote: pairing eight Rubin GPUs with dual AMD EPYC 9006 “Venice” processors
insights.locator: Aivres KL2288 2U Liquid-Cooled HGX Rubin NVL8 Compute Tray

insights.claim: Aivres lists the KL2288 at up to 400 PFLOPS NVFP4 inference and 280 PFLOPS NVFP4 training, with 2.3TB of HBM4 and 176TB/s of total HBM bandwidth.
insights.speaker: Vic A
insights.so_what: Vendor-quoted figures benchmark the generational step in per-node compute and memory bandwidth, and inference is rated well above training in NVFP4.
insights.quote: Aivres lists the KL2288 at up to 400 PFLOPS for NVFP4 inference and 280 PFLOPS for NVFP4 training.
insights.locator: Aivres lists the KL2288 at up to

insights.claim: The tray is fully fanless: CPUs have copper cold plates, the DDR5 DIMMs are also liquid-cooled, and the rear has OCP rack quick disconnects and a busbar with no fan exhaust area, so the design assumes facility liquid loops.
insights.speaker: Vic A
insights.so_what: Fanless designs force data centers to have liquid distribution in place, raising the bar for retrofits of air-cooled halls.
insights.quote: Aivres calls this a modular, fanless, fully liquid-cooled design.
insights.locator: Aivres calls this a modular, fanless

insights.claim: The front of the tray carries a UART port, two USB ports, two RJ45 ports, eight E1.S drive bays and room for an NVIDIA BlueField DPU, keeping storage and DPU networking in a dense 2U form factor.
insights.speaker: Vic A
insights.so_what: BlueField DPU support signals how NVIDIA's networking stack is bundled into each node.
insights.locator: The front has a UART port

insights.claim: Aivres' OCP Global Summit 2026 lineup spanned a Vera Rubin NVL72 rack, an HGX Rubin NVL8 tray, Vera CPU hardware, an HGX B300 server and a PCIe GPU server, showing a one-vendor NVIDIA product ladder from rack-scale to commodity form factors.
insights.speaker: Vic A
insights.so_what: HGX B300 sitting beside Rubin shows Blackwell Ultra systems remain the volume generation while Rubin ramps.
insights.quote: The lineup featured a lot of NVIDIA, spanning a Vera Rubin NVL72 rack down to a PCIe GPU server
insights.locator: At OCP Global Summit 2026 in San Jose
